# 04-hardware

Safety-chain hardware: requirements, electrical and safety-chain design, failure analysis, reliability data and PL calculation, electrical and battery safety, component qualification, mechanical, structural and stability analysis.

Standard clauses: ISO 13849-1 §6 and Annexes C–F, ISO 13849-2 Annexes A–D, IEC 60204-1 §5–§13 and §18, IEC 62133-2, IEC 60812, ASPICE HWE.1–4.
